newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - May 16.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Friday:
* The White House contends that welfare recipients placed in work programs are covered by minimum-wage laws.
* The Senate rejected two Democratic proposals that would have outlawed a broad category of abortions.
* Five players on the New York Knicks basketball team and one Miami Heat player have been suspended for their role in a melee during Game 5 of their series.
* The White House and Whitewater's independent counsel are in a war of words -- specifically what a White House appeal filed in Supreme Court should be called.
* U.S. prosecutors have decided to seek the death penalty in the case against accused Unabomber Theodore Kaczynski.
* The expansion of NATO threatens efforts in Russia's parliament to ratify an arms treaty negotiated with the United States.
* Canada Prime Minister Jean Chretien faces a tough fight as a grumpy electorate is disappointed that he has been unable to solve problems in his own backyard.
